Wall thickness (3 nm) calculated as (32−26)/2. T=3 represented ~94% of EncA particles purified from M. xanthus. Among recombinant empty EncA shells expressed in E. coli, T=3 represented ~80% in McHugh et al. 2014 and ~64% in Eren et al. 2022. Yadav & Beck 2026 further demonstrated that WT EncA T=3 formation during reassembly is strongly condition-dependent: Tris at low ionic strength favors T=3, whereas increasing ionic strength can shift assembly toward T=1 or unassembled species. Once formed, T=3 shells are kinetically trapped and do not interconvert with T=1 upon buffer exchange.
